definitions.gloss: holding an item; reservation of goods; setting aside
definitions.explanation: the practice of a store holding an item for a customer to purchase later; reserving merchandise before payment

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{置|お}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you hold this item for me?

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{置|お}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: We can hold items for up to three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{置|お}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧おいた{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I came to pick up the book I had asked them to hold over the phone.

notes:
FORMS:
{取|と}り{置|お}く (to set aside, to hold) → {取|と}り{置|お}き (noun form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {取|と}り{置|お}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to hold an item)
- {取|と}り{置|お}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask for an item to be held)
- {取|と}り{置|お}き⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (holding period)

SHOPPING CONTEXT:
Many Japanese stores offer {取|と}り{置|お}き service, allowing customers to reserve items for a limited period before purchasing. This is common in bookstores, clothing stores, and specialty shops.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{寄|よ}せ→取り寄せ：08307_toriyose⟧ (ordering in, special order)
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation - broader term)
